sol.10: Pick a window. The capture banner shows 4s and Cancel. The reordered list has Preview app above Photo editor, with Default still below both.
sol.11: Current DPI. The connected MX Master 2S shows 1000 and 50% battery. Disconnected, No device, and standard USB mouse have distinct on-page states.
sol.12: HID++ features. The named list starts with 0x0000 Root. Unnamed features uses two rows of hexadecimal chips alongside Copy IDs.
sol.13: Couldn't save assignment. Copy is still unsaved, with Try again and Back to editing. The conflict warning has Remapping paused, while the quit failure says Access denied.
sol.14: Start with Windows. The checkmark persists across both native tray menus while Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping.
sol.01: Buttons. Default has the checkmark above Preview app, and the sidebar keeps Connected and 50% visible in both themes.
sol.02: Other reported buttons. MX Master 4 has a sixth numbered Haptic Sense Panel, and Additional button 1 gets a separate Edit action row. The disconnected 2S retains the numbered diagram.
sol.03: Gesture button tap. Compact layout shows Win and Tab keycaps, while the offline list displays No device and still exposes the saved gesture mapping.
sol.04: Back button. Common includes Native action and Disabled, Edit shows six shortcuts, and the compact Tabs & windows picker shows Close tab selected. The Haptic Sense Panel editor points to marker 6 below the thumb wheel.
sol.05: No matching actions. The empty state offers Record a keyboard shortcut. The Copy search result shows Ctrl and C keycaps with a separate Assign button.
sol.06: Wheel mode button. Switch wheel mode shows Assign, while Switch pointer speed opens sliders displaying 800 DPI and 1600 DPI.
sol.07: Keyboard shortcut. The ordered sequence shows Record key, Press a key, draft M, draft M after resize, Native action after Cancel, draft K, the Back button mapped to K after Save, and Saved shortcut K on reopen.
sol.08: Wheel mode. SmartShift shows Flick sensitivity at 10 and Ignore accidental nudges at 4. The limited Always ratchet state shows the mode choices and two off toggles.
sol.09: Tap vs. swipe threshold. The enabled slider shows 60 counts. With Button gestures off, Saved gesture actions still shows the five editable mappings.

terra.10: Profiles: Preview app has preview.exe and Pick a window; window capture shows a 4s countdown.
terra.11: Device: Bluetooth, firmware, 50% battery, 1000 DPI and disconnected states appear.
terra.12: HID++ features: named feature IDs and unnamed feature chips with Copy IDs.
terra.13: Logi Options+ is running warning offers Quit Logi Options+; save error says Copy is still unsaved.
terra.14: Tray menu: Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping and Start with Windows is checked.
terra.01: Buttons: Profile menu shows Default checked and Preview app in both themes.
terra.02: Buttons: MX Master 4 has numbered Haptic Sense Panel and an Other reported buttons row.
terra.03: Buttons: compact mapping list shows Ctrl W Close tab and Ctrl T New tab.
terra.04: Back button: action editor shows category menu and six Edit actions.
terra.05: Back button: Copy search shows an Assign button; zzzz shows No matching actions.
terra.06: Wheel mode button: Switch pointer speed opens two DPI sliders and Save pointer speed action.
terra.07: Back button: shortcut sequence records M, cancels, saves K, and reopens with Saved shortcut K.
terra.08: Scroll: SmartShift selected with Flick sensitivity 10 and Ignore accidental nudges 4.
terra.09: Gestures: tap and four swipe rows show assignments; off state retains saved actions.

astra.10: Switch to the window you want to add. Window capture shows a 4s countdown and Cancel; profile ordering shows Move down on Preview app and Move up on Photo editor.
astra.11: Current DPI. Connected device shows Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006, 50% battery and 1000 DPI. Separate panels show Disconnected, No device, and USB mouse.
astra.12: HID++ features. Named rows begin with 0x0000 Root and include 0x2201 Adjustable DPI; Unnamed features appear as ID chips beside Copy IDs.
astra.13: Couldn't save assignment. The editor explicitly says Copy is still unsaved and offers Try again and Back to editing. Conflict states show a Logi Options+ warning with Quit Logi Options+ and an access-denied error.
astra.14: Quit Mushak. Native tray menus show Pause remapping or Resume remapping and a check beside Start with Windows.
astra.01: Buttons. Dark and light shells show the Profile dropdown with Default checked and Preview app below; amber selection marks Buttons in the left navigation.
astra.02: Haptic Sense Panel. MX Master 4 artwork has six numbered markers; Additional button 1 appears separately with Control ID 0x01FF. MX Master 2S dark artwork has a conspicuous gray rectangular background. Offline screens say changes apply when a mouse connects.
astra.03: Gesture button tap. Compact rows pair Ctrl W with Close tab and Ctrl T with New tab; the offline Preview app list shows Native action for Back, Forward, and Middle click.
astra.04: Back button. The Common category separates Button behavior from Shortcuts, the category menu lists Edit and Tabs & windows, and the compact picker highlights Close tab. Haptic Sense Panel has a marked thumb-panel crop.
astra.05: No matching actions. Copy search returns one Edit result with Ctrl and C keycaps plus Assign; the empty search offers Record a keyboard shortcut.
astra.06: Switch between two pointer speeds. The wheel editor shows Speed 1: 800 DPI and Speed 2: 1600 DPI above Save pointer speed action. The preceding action list contains Switch wheel mode and Switch pointer speed.
astra.07: Saved shortcut. Ordered states show Actions, empty shortcut, Press a key, draft M, a compact resized draft M, Cancel returning to Native action, draft K, saved K on the button list, and reopened Saved shortcut K. Both themes show the same sequence.
astra.08: Flick sensitivity. SmartShift is selected with value 10, Ignore accidental nudges is 4, and High-resolution scrolling is enabled. The limited screen selects Always ratchet and omits both sliders.
astra.09: Gesture recognition is off. Enabled gestures show a 60 counts threshold and five mappings; disabled gestures retain editable Saved gesture actions while omitting the threshold.
